corrections.reason: The Ge'ez conditional particle at the end of line 2 joining onto line 3 is 'እመቦ ብእሲ' (Luke 11:5), with the 6th-order 'እ' clearly visible on the page.
In Luke 11:9 ('Seek and you shall find'), the plural imperative verb is 'ኅሡ' (with 2nd-order kā'eb 'ሡ' having the right-leg vowel tick), which was misread as 1st-order 'ሠ'.
